Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files and demanding ransom
Side-loading malicious dynamic-link libraries to disrupt endpoint protection
Exploiting vulnerabilities such as ProxyShell and PetitPotam to take over Windows domains and encrypt devices
Discoverer: RE - CERT malware analyst Jiří Vinopal
Impacted Systems: Confluence Server and Data Center servers vulnerable to patched and actively exploited bugs
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched servers (ProxyShell, PetitPotam vulnerabilities)
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with unknown or proprietary formats that may not decrypt
